title: Mark GetAddress.io objects as obsolete
summary: GetAddress.io UK postcode app objects are marked obsolete. Its page extensions and the test app were removed, and the remaining tables, pages, codeunits and permission set extensions now carry obsolete markings. The app is already uninstalled from tenants as of 28.3.
key_points: Page extensions providing address lookup integration have been removed
Test code for the GetAddress.io functionality has been deleted
Core objects marked with obsolete attribute and deprecation messages
Configuration and permission sets updated to reflect obsolescence
App was already uninstalled from existing tenants as of 28.3
